stories.title: Welsh Water handed £44.7m ‘enforcement package’ over sewage failures
stories.summary: Welsh Water will pay out £44.7 million after failures in its sewage network and oversight led to a series of spills and must now focus on “putting things right”, regulator Ofwat has announced. stories.title: Hawarden teenager targets quadcross world championship after sponsorship from Deeside homebuilder
stories.summary: A 17-year-old quadcross rider from Hawarden is preparing to compete in the FIM Quad Cross World Championship after receiving sponsorship from Ewloe-based Anwyl Homes. stories.title: Seventeen cyclists to ride 117 miles on Saturday in memory of Northop Cricket Club member
stories.summary: A group of cyclists from Northop will ride 117 miles on Saturday in memory of Simon Jones, a sportsman and Northop Cricket Club member who passed away in October 2025. stories.title: Birkenhead man sentenced after violent attack on woman in Hawarden
stories.summary: A Birkenhead man has been sentenced after pleading guilty to assaulting a woman in Hawarden and a series of driving offences. Gordon Duncan, 32, of Devonshire Road, Birkenhead, appeared at Mold Crown Court today, Thursday 4 June, for sentencing.
